description: This PHP class 'CandidateAttachmentDecorator' is part of the OrangeHRM system, providing a decorator pattern for the CandidateAttachment entity. It includes methods to retrieve file content and associate a candidate by ID, utilizing traits and external entity classes.

classes.name: CandidateAttachmentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for CandidateAttachment providing additional methods and encapsulating core entity functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a CandidateAttachment instance.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Returns the file contents of the attachment, reading stream resources if necessary.

methods.name: setCandidateById
methods.description: Associates a Candidate entity with the attachment based on a given candidate ID.
